to be involved with others in doing something to take part in an activity or event with others 与他人一起参与某事，与他人一起参加某项活动或事件 Most people joined the game, but a few chose not to participate. 大多数人加入了游戏，但有少数人选择不参与。 If you don't participate in the planning of the trip, you can't complain about what we plan. 如果你不参与旅行的规划，就不能抱怨我们所做的安排。 He never participated in sports in high school. 他在高中时从未参加过体育运动。 Participating employees [=employees who have chosen to join] can contribute up to 14 percent of their wages to the retirement plan.

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 7611f666-35f0-4a0a-b373-ace6d9f9d346 c3c271a6-ab11-409e-9f4f-adeac67baccb daily adjective ˈdeɪli https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/d/daily001.wav happening, done, made, used, or existing every day 每天发生、完成、制造、使用或存在的 Television has become a part of our daily [=day-to-day] lives. 电视已经成为我们日常生活的一部分。 It has changed every aspect of daily life/existence. 它改变了日常生活/存在的方方面面。 I started eating healthier and added exercise to my daily routine/schedule. 我开始吃得更健康，并将锻炼加入到我的日常生活/日程中。 daily activities such as eating breakfast and washing your face
There's not enough water to meet the daily needs of the city's people.
daily commuters
He visits them on a daily basis. [=every day]
people working to earn their daily bread [=the food they need each day] 日常活动，如吃早餐和洗脸
水资源不足，无法满足城市居民的日常需求。
每日通勤者
他每天都去看望他们。
为挣每日口粮而工作的人们 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k b3d1386b-0da1-45e2-9f7b-373f721e7963 c3c271a6-ab11-409e-9f4f-adeac67baccb daily adjective ˈdeɪli https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/d/daily001.wav published every day or every day except Sunday 每天出版或除星期天外的每天出版 daily newspapers 日报 She reads the daily paper each morning. 她每天早上都会读日报。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k e80726e2-7c7f-44b9-9174-5318309e5fd5 c3c271a6-ab11-409e-9f4f-adeac67baccb daily adjective ˈdeɪli https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/d/daily001.wav of or relating to one day 关于一天的；与一天有关的 Their average daily wage is only five dollars. 他们的平均日工资只有五美元。 She had been taking more than the recommended daily dose of the medicine. 她一直在服用超过建议每日剂量的药物。 Our daily lunch specials [=the special lunch items offered on particular days of the week] are listed on the back of the menu. 我们的每日午餐特价菜品（即每周特定日子提供的特色午餐）列在菜单背面。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 9b191980-460d-4b95-8323-519bf66cd2bf 8e27d841-03e6-4c9f-a967-8a16d2d43abd fair adjective ˈfeɚ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fair0001.wav agreeing with what is thought to be right or acceptable 同意被认为是正确或可接受的事情 We received fair treatment. 我们受到了公正的对待。 fair elections 公平选举 a fair fight 一场公平的战斗 a fair bargain/deal/trade
I'm just trying to get a fair price for the house. [=I'm not trying to get more money for the house than most people think is right]
That's a fair question, and it deserves an honest reply.
The workers claim that they are not being paid fair wages. [=they are being paid less than they should be paid]
It's only fair [=it is the right thing] to tell him the truth.
I washed the dishes yesterday, so it's only fair (that) you to do them today.
He gets his fair share of attention too. [=he gets a reasonable amount of attention]
She's had more than her fair share of trouble. [=she has had a lot of trouble] 公平的交易/买卖/交换
我只是想为这套房子得到一个公平的价格。
这是个合理的问题，值得一个诚实的回答。
工人们声称他们没有拿到合理的工资。
告诉他真相才是公正的。
我昨天洗了碗，所以你今天洗才公平。
他也得到了他应得的关注。
她经历的麻烦已经远超她应得的份额。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

Sometimes life isn't fair.
a fair and impartial jury
a bargain/deal/trade that is fair to/for everyone
All she wants is a fair chance. [=the same chance everyone else gets] 她能早退而我不能，这不公平。
有时候生活就是不公平。
一个公正无私的陪审团
对每个人都公平的交易/协议/买卖
她只想要一个公平的机会。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

Parts of it are actually pretty funny.” “多么糟糕的一部电影！” “公平点！其中有些部分其实挺有趣的。” I can't say I liked the movie, but, to be fair, parts of it are pretty funny. 我不能说我喜欢这部电影，但公平地说，其中有些部分确实挺有趣的。 She did poorly on the test, but, to be fair, so did a lot of other people. 她这次考试考得不好，但说句公道话，很多其他人也考得不好。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

The food was fair to middling. [=just average; not especially good] 病人的病情已从严重转为一般。
食物一般般。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

“I'm guessing that he's about 50 years old.” “That's a fair guess, but he's actually almost 60.” 很有可能天气很快就会好转。
“我猜他大约50岁。” “这个猜测还算合理，但他实际上快60岁了。” eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

I can't do everything at once—I've only got one pair of hands. [=I am only one person]
It will take two pairs of hands [=two people] to move this rock. 她用一对A赢了。
我不能同时做所有事情——我只有一双手。
搬动这块石头需要两双手。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k f94ff281-c0f6-4a98-b183-641f3f72e539 ff88f4d8-d6ca-4468-b47d-5135b0cd97e1 pair noun ˈpeɚ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/p/pair0001.wav count two animals that mate together 两种会交配的动物 To avoid competition, breeding/mating pairs stay away from other male chimpanzees. 为了避免竞争，繁殖/交配的配偶会远离其他雄性黑猩猩。 A pair of parrots can raise one chick each year. 一对鹦鹉每年可以养育一只雏鸟。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

known or recognized by very many people having fame 为许多人所知或认可，拥有名气；著名的，有名的。 an internationally famous hotel 一家国际知名的酒店 a famous entertainer/explorer/athlete/politician 著名的娱乐人士/探险家/运动员/政治家 The hotel is (justly) famous for its luxury. 这家酒店以其奢华（实至名归）而闻名。 The hotel is famous as the place where the treaty was signed. 这家酒店因是签署条约的地方而闻名。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23
